planets.name: WASP-59 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-59 with a 7.92-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-59 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-59. Its orbit and size follow Hebrard et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.
